# FIELD NOTES implementation

- Scope: one standalone `index.html`, inline CSS/JS, no build or dependencies. Supplied copy, section IDs and four link destinations retained; no added claims or sections. Guidance: selected local `qs-design-frontend` root and its brief, design-direction, implementation, restrained-style, cinematic-landing and selected media recipes. Parameters: effort=standard, report=brief.
- Design: #f6f3eb paper, #163b43 ink, #bf4e2e accent; system sans; square controls. Fluid gutters 24–64px; layout breakpoints 600/1100px; short-landscape adjustment below 500px height. Ink primary control with accent edge gives 10.88:1 text contrast against paper. Text stays outside footage.
- Media: R3 background footage + R4 framing. Repository-owned synthetic fixtures verified by supplied `assets/rights.json`; no media obtained externally. Same poster/video crop: cover, 70% horizontal / 65% vertical focal point; frame ratios 2.65 desktop, 2 tablet, 1.18 mobile. Silent inline native loop (~1.965s), intersection trigger, no entrance delay, scrubbing, pinning or loop fade. Navigation and content stay static. Link hover transitions 160ms ease-out; reduced motion disables transitions and smooth scrolling.
- Playback: poster-first; no HTML autoplay. JS starts visible footage, pauses offscreen or in hidden tabs, preserves explicit pause, and tears down observers/listeners on page exit. Reduced-motion preference keeps the poster. Playback rejection permits manual retry; missing/unsupported media, unavailable observation and interrupted initialization retain static content. All failure limitations belong here rather than adding product copy.
- Verification: local Firefox 159 headless with isolated workspace profiles and native WebDriver BiDi. Screenshots inspected at 375×812, 768×1024, 1440×1000 and 812×375; no horizontal overflow. Computed palette, system font and zero control radius checked. Real WebM time advancement, start/middle/end frames and four natural loop boundaries checked. Keyboard tab order/focus, Enter pause/resume, persistent pause, emulated touch pause and recovery after rejected playback passed. Fully offscreen pause, hidden-tab pause/resume and teardown passed. Work/About anchors and exact mailto checked. Native reduced-motion and JavaScript-disabled profiles retained poster and all links. Injected missing-video, rejected-playback and unavailable-observer cases retained usable static content. Page console had no unexpected errors in normal checks. Asset paths and unique IDs passed a local audit.
- Actual limitations: configured browser connector lacked its expected executable, so checks used the installed Firefox binary directly; no installation was performed. Coverage is desktop headless Firefox with viewport/touch emulation, not physical mobile hardware or other engines. Default system font rendering varies by platform. No external services, remote fonts, new assets or publication were used. Initial preferred local server ports were occupied; checks used an automatically assigned workspace-only HTTP server.
